headline: S&P Global (SPGI) Launches Private Markets Intelligence And New AI Data Tools
summary: S&P Global (NYSE:SPGI) has rolled out integrated private markets intelligence on Capital IQ Pro with data from With Intelligence. The company has also introduced Adaptive Retrieval and Deterministic Retrieval tools on the S&P Global AI Data Portal. These updates are designed to support clients across private equity, private credit, hedge funds and wealth segments.
